source: User: If our readership exceeds 500 people, switch the newsletter to a paid delivery service. Until then, keep the current setup.
candidate: Switch newsletter delivery services only if readership exceeds 500.

source: User: I think I work better with instrumental music, but I am still trying it out.
candidate: The user tentatively finds instrumental music helpful for work.

source: User: According to the vendor, the printer supports duplex scanning. We have not verified it.
candidate: The vendor reports duplex scanning support; the team has not verified it.

source: User: Usually choose the cheaper shipping option unless the delivery is urgent.
candidate: The user generally prefers cheaper shipping, except for urgent deliveries.

source: User: For public datasets we allow external processing; confidential datasets must stay on our servers.
candidate: Confidential datasets must stay on the team servers.

source: User: The current estimate for the migration is two to four weeks, not a firm commitment.
candidate: The migration is estimated at two to four weeks, without a firm commitment.

source: User: Our monthly archive normally runs on the first Monday, unless that day is a holiday.
candidate: The monthly archive normally runs on the first Monday, except holidays.

source: User: Contractors can access the staging environment only after the owner approves their request.
candidate: Contractor staging access requires owner approval.

source: User: We suspect the cache is causing the intermittent bug; it is our working hypothesis, not a confirmed diagnosis.
candidate: The cache is a working hypothesis for the intermittent bug, not a confirmed cause.
why: Ongoing debugging context with hypothesis status.

source: User: I may prefer a compact keyboard, but I want to borrow one before deciding.
candidate: The user is considering a compact keyboard and wants to try one first.
why: Tentative preference and next step preserved.

source: User: We can publish the recording if every participant consents.
candidate: The team may publish the recording without participant consent.

source: User: The supplier may deliver by Thursday, but has not confirmed a date.
candidate: The supplier guarantees delivery by Thursday.

source: User: Never send an invoice automatically unless a manager has approved it.
candidate: Invoices should always be sent automatically.

source: User: I sometimes enjoy jazz while cooking, but not while reading.
candidate: The user always prefers jazz while reading.
why: Reverses activity scope and strengthens frequency.

source: User: The estimate is between 12 and 18 hours.
candidate: The task will take exactly 12 hours.

source: User: This fallback is for internal test builds only.
candidate: The fallback is approved for customer-facing production builds.

source: User: The policy applies to full-time employees, not volunteers.
candidate: The policy applies to all volunteers.

source: User: The next train might be late; check the platform display right now.
candidate: The next train might be late.
why: Transient travel update rather than durable context.

source: User: Use the backup only when that condition is met.
candidate: Use the backup when traffic exceeds 1,000 requests per minute.

source: User: It seems more suitable, though I do not know for which team yet.
candidate: The analytics team tentatively prefers this solution.
why: The team and referent are unresolved.
